An Air Crash

一次空难 · 218 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1I used to work as a typist in a post office. Because I could no longer tolerate typing postage bills and postcodes on a typewriter every day, I resigned. Eager to make big money, I took a job as a business representative for the G.E. Ecology Company, which produced goods by recycling useful materials from our dustbins. Many aspects of my new job made a good impression on me. The main drawback was that my work timetable involved frequent travel by jet.

2Once, as our jet was speeding up, it flew into a thunderstorm that knocked out our GPS receiver and made us lose our sense of direction. A constantly flashing light showed that our jet was in danger. A steward instantly asked us to put on masks and fasten our seat belts, and then pressed a button to switch on the escape capsule. It slid sideways out of the opening at once and landed safely in a desert area. Lacking food and tablets, we were nervous and uncertain at first. But we all stayed optimistic and adapted well to the situation. We gathered the mud around us to build a temporary shelter and were soon back on our feet. Finally, guided by smoke rising from the crashed jet, some local residents came by carriage and saved us.

一次空难

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1我以前在邮局做打字员。每天都要用打字机打邮资账单和邮政编码，我实在受不了了，就辞了职。一心想多赚钱的我当上了 G.E. 生态公司的业务代表。那家公司从垃圾桶里回收有用的材料，再把它们制成商品。新工作很多地方都让我印象不错，就是行程排得太满，得经常坐喷气式飞机出差。

2有一次，飞机正在加速，突然冲进一场雷暴。雷暴毁坏了 GPS 接收器，我们失去了方向。一盏灯不停闪烁，表示飞机有危险。一名乘务员立刻让我们戴上面罩、系好安全带，随后按下按钮启动逃生舱。逃生舱马上从开口侧向滑了出去，安全降落在沙漠地带。缺少食物和药片，大家起初既紧张又没把握。好在我们都保持乐观，很快适应了处境。我们把附近的泥土聚到一起搭了个临时住处，没过多久就重新振作起来。最后，有些当地居民循着失事飞机冒出的烟，坐着马车赶来救了我们。
